meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 获得把网页应用部署到 Vercel 的能力:它会安装 Vercel 命令行工具,并让 OneCLI 在访问 api.vercel.com 时自动带上你的访问令牌。之后 Claude 可执行部署、查看部署列表、确认登录状态等操作。
howto.when: 当用户想让代理把网页应用部署到 Vercel 时触发;也出现在用户要求安装或配置此能力(如发起 /add-vercel)时。

say.text: 把当前项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: Claude 会执行生产部署并返回线上地址。

say.text: 帮我查看 Vercel 上现有的部署列表
say.note: Claude 会调用 vercel ls 列出部署。

say.text: 把这个应用部署到 Vercel 并告诉我状态

howto.what_en: This skill gives Claude the ability to deploy web apps to Vercel: it installs the Vercel CLI and sets up OneCLI to automatically inject an access token for api.vercel.com. Claude can then run deployments, list deployments, and check auth.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants an agent to deploy web applications to Vercel, or when requesting this capability (e.g., via /add-vercel).

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Claude will deploy to production and share the URL.

say_en.text: List the existing deployments on Vercel.
say_en.note: Claude will run vercel ls to show deployments.

say_en.text: Deploy this app to Vercel and tell me the status.
say_en.note: Claude will run vercel deploy and report the result.
